name: Calendar
summary: One month laid out as a seven-column grid. It draws the month and marks the days; which month to show is the host's business, because a grid cannot know which months exist.
summaryZh: 一个按七列排开的月份。它负责画出这个月并标出日子;显示哪个月是宿主的事,因为一张网格不知道有哪些月份可选。

variants.name: Bordered
variants.note: The panel has a frame and a rule under the weekday names. The base class on its own is this, and the modifier paints the same thing so the class list can name it.

variants.name: Plain
variants.note: The panel drops its frame, its fill and the rule, so the grid sits straight on the page.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The day numbers take the caption size and the cells take the small control height.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default size. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: The day numbers take the title size and the cells take the large control height.

states.name: Today
states.note: The day the reader is looking for. Its number sits in a filled circle: a solid brand surface with the brand's own foreground, which is the pair the contract measures for a filled surface that carries text.

states.name: Selected
states.note: The day the reader has picked. The ring around it carries the meaning and carries no text, so it takes the graphic form of the brand colour, which is contracted to 3:1 rather than to the 4.5:1 of text.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: A day that cannot be picked. Its number takes the derived disabled colour, the way every other disabled control in the library dims. The state is aria-disabled rather than a class of its own: a grid cell has no disabled attribute, so the reader is told the day cannot be picked the way um-link is told, and the way the WAI-ARIA date picker grid marks a date that is not available.

parts.name: Header
parts.note: The row of weekday names. It is a grid row, so it lines up with the days under it.

parts.name: Weekday
parts.note: One weekday name. It is a column header, so the browser says which column a day belongs to.

parts.name: Grid
parts.note: The days. It is a grid of seven columns, one column per weekday.

parts.name: Week
parts.note: One row of seven days. The row is what a screen reader reads across, so the days stay in one line.

parts.name: Cell
parts.note: One day. It carries the state class when the day is not an ordinary one.

parts.name: Number
parts.note: The day of the month. It is the circle the today marker fills.

props.name: variant
props.description: The shape of the panel. The bordered run is the base class on its own; the plain run adds um-calendar--plain.
props.descriptionZh: 面板的样子。带边框就是只写基类;无边框再加上 um-calendar--plain。

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the day numbers and of the cells.
props.descriptionZh: 日期数字和日期格的尺寸。

props.name: month
props.description: The month to draw, written as YYYY-MM. The calendar has no navigation of its own, so the host decides which month this is.
props.descriptionZh: 要画的那个月,写成 YYYY-MM。日历自己不带翻页,所以哪个月由宿主决定。

props.name: weekdays
props.description: The seven column names, separated by commas. They are written out rather than derived, so a month can start on Monday or on Sunday, and so a host can name the columns in its own language.
props.descriptionZh: 七列的名字,用逗号分开。它们是写下来的而不是算出来的,所以一周可以从星期一开始,也可以从星期日开始,宿主也能用自己的语言写这七个名字。

props.name: today
props.description: The date that is today, written as YYYY-MM-DD. The day it names takes the today marker.
props.descriptionZh: 今天是哪一天,写成 YYYY-MM-DD。被指到的那一天会带上今天的标记。

props.name: selected
props.description: The date the reader has picked, written as YYYY-MM-DD. The day it names takes the selected marker.
props.descriptionZh: 读者选中的那一天,写成 YYYY-MM-DD。被指到的那一天会带上选中的标记。

props.name: disabled
props.description: The dates that cannot be picked, written as YYYY-MM-DD and separated by commas. The days they name are marked with aria-disabled, so the reader is told they cannot be picked.
props.descriptionZh: 不能选的几天,写成 YYYY-MM-DD,中间用逗号分开。被指到的那些天会带上 aria-disabled,所以读屏会知道它们选不了。

a11y.notes: The panel is the grid: the weekday names are a row of column headers and the weeks are rows of grid cells, so the browser says which column a day belongs to and a reader can walk the week across. The day numbers are real text, so the grid can be read without seeing it. A day that cannot be picked carries aria-disabled, so the reader is told that day is unavailable; the other two markers are classes and not attributes, so the reader is not told which day is today or which one is selected: the host has to say that in the markup or in the text around the grid.
a11y.notesZh: 面板就是这张网格:星期名是一行列标题,每一周是一行网格单元,所以浏览器会说明某一天属于哪一列,读者也能横着读一周。日期是真正的文字,所以这张网格不看也能读。不能选的那几天带着 aria-disabled,所以读屏会知道那天不可用;另外两个标记是类而不是属性,所以读屏不会说哪一天是今天、哪一天被选中:这件事得由宿主写进标记里,或者写进网格旁边的文字里。

examples.title: A month
examples.description: November 2026. The 28th is today, the 20th is the day that was picked, and the 5th and the 6th cannot be picked. The empty cells at the front of the first week are the days of October the month does not have.
examples.descriptionZh: 2026 年 11 月。28 号是今天,20 号是被选中的那天,5 号和 6 号不能选。第一周前面那些空格是这个月没有的十月份的日子。

notes: The calendar has no navigation of its own. A month is a grid of days, and a grid cannot know which months exist, so the host owns the month and the host owns the buttons that change it; what the calendar gives the host is a grid it can drop into any panel. The three markers are kept apart on purpose: today is a filled circle with a number on it, so it is a surface with text and takes the brand's on-colour; selected is a ring with nothing on it, so it is a shape and takes the graphic form of the brand colour; disabled is a number that takes the derived disabled colour. The weekday names are written out rather than derived, because a month may start on Monday or on Sunday and a host may name the columns in its own language.
notesZh: 日历自己不带翻页。一个月是一张日期的网格,而网格不知道有哪些月份可选,所以月份归宿主管,翻页的按钮也归宿主管;日历给宿主的只是一张能放进任何面板里的网格。三个标记是刻意分开的:今天是填满的圆,圆上有数字,所以它是一块带字的表面,用的是品牌色的 on 色;选中是一个圈,圈里没有字,所以它是一个形状,用的是品牌色的 graphic 形态;禁用是一个数字,用的是派生出来的禁用色。星期名是写下来的而不是算出来的,因为一个月可以从星期一开始也可以从星期日开始,宿主也可以用自己的语言写这七个名字。
